{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''prison colony''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor V/Legends|Clak'dor V]] by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] early in their history, when religious persecution was high in the early days of Bith spaceflight. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the prison was rediscovered and kept quarantined by Bith authorities, who hoped to keep its origins secret.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Hidden Sins}}</ref>
